resources.title: GR-LIO: A Local Ground-Aware LiDAR-Inertial Odometry System Using Body-to-Ground Height
resources.reading_boundary: Abstract, Note to Practitioners, III, IV including IV-D; selected V-E efficiency discussion. No independent reproduction or full equation audit.

claims.claim: Body-ground geometry and local planar motion assumptions
Ground-point residuals avoid nearest-neighbor association and planar update targets vertical drift
Disable ground-aware update when planar consistency fails

open_questions: Quadruped gait, body-ground height variation and independent ground normal estimation require separate validation.
Full mathematical consistency and implementation have not been audited.
Potential plane-offset sign inconsistency in v1 HTML Eq. 5 under Eq. 1 convention; Eq. 20 and Eq. 23 require cross-check. Implementation and PDF not audited.
